item.title: What Qwen3.8's MoE Lineup Means for Sizing Your Local Rig
item.description: Qwen released 3.8-27B alongside a much larger 3.8-Max, and the r/LocalLLaMA thread reacting to it turned into a decent snapshot of what people are actually planning to run on their own hardware. Buried under the celebration (“still waiting for 3.8 35b a3b, but excited for the 27b version,” one top comment put it) is a pretty clear map of which model shapes this community wants and why.
